purpose: Assess whether 284b Level A 12-taxon source agreement survives restoration of the 510 originally absent GBIF source parquet objects, without mutating the prospectively frozen September-2026 experiment.

repaired_snapshot.restored_filename_rule: six-digit numeric basenames exactly divisible by 20

staged_gates.G0: exact original and repaired S3 manifest hashes verified
staged_gates.G1: reproduce original source thinned input denominators and confirm no historical source-row identity drift, including original Artemisia 3285 and 4516 counts
staged_gates.G2: quantify restored raw source-record exposure in all predeclared taxa and identify whether source modes are differentially affected
staged_gates.G3: full repaired-source refit of all 47+12 original taxon inventories, no replacement or favourable procedure/area subset
staged_gates.G4: recalibrate a newly versioned 24-cell reference using the original 47 taxa and new adequacy gates
staged_gates.G5: evaluate all 12 original heldout taxa against the new reference once, report 288 cell states (including unresolved), no candidate swapping
staged_gates.G6: compare paired old vs repaired taxon-level max-to-q95 ratio and reference shift, detect whether 0/12 pass persists or not

primary_robustness_reporting: Count of the 12 heldout taxa with any new q95 envelope exceedance vs original 0/12
Number of evaluable/attention_required/unresolved procedure x M heldout cells
Per-taxon change in max observed / calibrated envelope ratio (taxon is independent unit)
Reference q95 shifts by each of 24 procedure x M cells
Differential source-mode changes in admitted and spatially thinned input records
prohibitions: Do not reinterpret the repaired-source run as new independent holdout taxa
Do not reuse old q95 as a nominal alpha or 95% predictive bound
Do not alter fixed taxa, procedures, M or predictor universe after restored counts are visible
Do not claim biological truth or source-independent external accuracy from source coherence
Do not modify the original signed 0/12 empirical endpoint
If any required 24 reference cells lacks 30 adequate taxa, STOP and report unresolved rather than removing cells
submission_impact: Ecology Letters M1+M2 manuscript cannot claim robustness to repaired public GBIF directory before a distinct versioned repaired-source sensitivity conclusion or explicit editor-agreed limitation.
